manifest.name: CRM Mail Plugin
manifest.summary: Turn emails received in your mailbox into leads and log their content as internal notes.
manifest.author: Odoo S.A.

behavioral_notes.observation: The active lead-creation endpoint the plugin calls from the inbox sidebar. It browse()+exists()-validates the supplied partner_id (returning {'error': 'partner_not_found'} when the partner is gone), then creates a crm.lead with_company(partner.company_id) using name=html2plaintext(email_subject), partner_id, and description=email_body (the raw email content). It returns {'lead_id': record.id}. No stage/team is set here, so crm's own create defaults (default team/stage, PLS probability) apply downstream; type defaults to 'lead'.

This module does NOT enrich partners itself; it extends the parent mail_plugin._get_contact_data to append a 'leads' key to the sidebar contact card. _fetch_partner_leads searches crm.lead by partner_id (limit 5) and returns lead_id/name/expected_revenue/probability per lead, adding recurring_revenue+recurring_plan only when the user has crm.group_use_recurring_revenues. The 'leads' key is only added when crm.lead.has_access('create') is True, so the CRM section disappears for users who cannot create leads (graceful degradation, mimicking CRM-not-installed).

Every jsonrpc plugin route uses the custom 'outlook' auth method (inherited from mail_plugin, not defined here). It reads the HTTP Authorization header, strips a leading 'Bearer ' prefix, and validates the token via res.users.apikeys._check_credentials(scope='odoo.plugin.outlook'); on success it switches request env to that API-key user. The token is minted by mail_plugin's authenticate.py: an HMAC-signed (mail_plugin secret) auth_code, valid 3 minutes, is exchanged at /mail_plugin/auth/access_token for a 1-day res.users.apikeys key. So the bearer-token plumbing lives entirely in the parent module.

behavioral_notes.element: IAP enrichment ownership (inherited, not in this module)
behavioral_notes.observation: Lead/company enrichment is a parent-module concern, not crm_mail_plugin's: mail_plugin._iap_enrich calls request.env['iap.enrich.api']._request_enrich({domain}) (handling InsufficientCreditError), and res_partner_get/_create_company_from_iap build a res.partner from the IAP reveal data. crm_mail_plugin only adds the CRM lead layer on top of the already-resolved partner; the email-to-partner lookup (email_normalized search, notification-address guard, IAP create) all happens in mail_plugin.res_partner_get before this module's lead list is attached.

behavioral_notes.element: deprecated saas-14.3 compatibility routes + server action
behavioral_notes.observation: Four of the five routes (log_single_mail_content, lead/get_by_partner_id, lead/create_from_partner, lead/open) are documented 'deprecated as of saas-14.3' shims kept only for older plugin clients. lead/create_from_partner (auth='user', http GET) redirects to the lead_creation_prefilled_action ir.actions.server, which calls crm.lead._form_view_auto_fill() to open a lead form pre-filled with default_partner_id from the URL params. lead/open redirects to the standard crm.crm_lead_view_form in edit mode. log_single_mail_content just message_post(body=message) onto a browsed lead.

No OWL/JS: 0 js_files, no registry adds, no patches. The 2 xml_templates are backend view data (crm_mail_plugin_lead.xml server-action record + crm_lead_views.xml), not client assets. The actual sidebar UI lives in the Outlook/Gmail add-in client (external to Odoo) and the shared HTML/translation templates in the parent mail_plugin; this module is purely a route+ORM backend.

it_architecture.application: crm_mail_plugin (mail-plugin CRM backend; auto-installed bridge between crm and mail_plugin)
logical_data_erm: crm.lead -> res.partner (partner_id, supplied by parent mail_plugin lookup)
information_flows: depends: crm, mail_plugin (inherits outlook auth, IAP enrich, partner lookup)
inbound: Outlook/Gmail add-in -> Bearer token (Authorization header) -> _auth_method_outlook -> res.users.apikeys validation
side-effect: /mail_plugin/lead/create -> crm.lead.create (name from email subject, description from email body, partner_id) -> CRM default team/stage/PLS apply
read-flow: _get_contact_data override -> _fetch_partner_leads -> crm.lead search by partner_id surfaced in sidebar contact card
upstream dependency: mail_plugin.res_partner_get resolves/enriches the partner (IAP reveal) before this module attaches its lead list

capabilities: Surface a Contact's Open Leads/Opportunities in the Mail Sidebar
Log Email Content onto a Lead (internal note)
Pre-filled Lead Creation from a Known Contact
value_streams: Inbox-to-Lead: read email -> resolve/enrich sender as partner (parent) -> one-click create crm.lead with subject+body -> hand off to CRM pipeline
Contact context loop: open an email -> see that contact's existing leads (revenue/probability) without leaving the mailbox
policies: Capability gating: the 'leads' section and crm.lead logging are exposed only when crm.lead.has_access('create') is True
outlook bearer-token policy: 1-day res.users.apikeys (scope odoo.plugin.outlook) minted from a 3-minute HMAC auth code
stakeholders: Salesperson / Internal User (reads inbox, creates leads)

classification.apqc_category: 3.0 Market and Sell Products and Services (3.5.1 Manage leads)
classification.rationale: crm_mail_plugin is a thin lead-acquisition extension of CRM (a value-shop): it captures and qualifies prospects from inbox interactions, feeding the CRM diagnose-qualify-nurture loop rather than transforming inputs into outputs along a chain. The core activity is turning an inbound email into a crm.lead and surfacing a contact's existing pipeline in the mailbox, i.e. lead capture at the very front of the value-shop. It inherits CRM's shop classification and is a primary activity under APQC 3.0 Market and Sell, specifically 3.5.1 lead management. It is a feeder/bridge (auto_install) onto crm.lead, not its own value stream, but the work it performs is lead capture, hence 'shop'/'primary' rather than 'support'.

standard_capabilities: one-click lead creation from an email (subject->name, body->description, sender->partner_id)
show a contact's existing leads (expected revenue, probability) in the add-in contact card
log email content as an internal note / message on a lead
access-gated CRM section that hides when the user cannot create leads
typical_fits: sales reps triaging shared/personal mailboxes who want inbox-to-lead capture
standard crm.lead defaulting (team, stage, PLS probability) on plugin-created leads
Outlook and Gmail add-ins using the shared mail_plugin auth/enrich plumbing
common_gaps: no custom stage/team/source assignment on plugin-created leads (uses crm defaults only)
no UTM/lead-source attribution stamped by the plugin path
lead enrichment/dedup is delegated to mail_plugin IAP + crm cron, not configurable here
deprecated saas-14.3 routes retained for old clients add surface area but no new value
drive_hints: odoo shell: p = env['res.partner'].search([('email','!=',False)], limit=1); l = env['crm.lead'].with_company(p.company_id).create({'name':'Inbox subject','partner_id':p.id,'description':'email body'}); (l.id, l.type, l.team_id.name)
odoo shell: env['crm.lead'].search([('partner_id','=',p.id)], limit=5).mapped(lambda r: (r.name, r.expected_revenue, r.probability))

open_questions: Exact behavior of crm.lead defaults (team_id/stage_id/user_id) for a plugin-created lead with no salesperson context beyond with_company.
Whether any current add-in client still calls the four saas-14.3-deprecated routes or only /mail_plugin/lead/create.
Whether email_body/description is sanitized for HTML beyond the html2plaintext applied to the subject.
